# Gorgeous Core: instructions for GitHub Copilot

Follow the repository-wide [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before coding, documenting, committing or opening a pull request.

**Jira tracing is required for tracked work.** Find the real Gorgeous Things issue key, put it in relevant commit subjects (`GT-123: Short summary`), and, where practical, in the branch name and PR title. Link `https://epicnova.atlassian.net/browse/GT-123` in the PR body, with tests and acceptance-criteria coverage. Never fabricate issue keys, attach unrelated keys, or automatically mark Jira Done from a merge.

See [.github/DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md) for the full workflow. GitHub for Jira must be connected for automatic development-panel association.
